Hi Caroline,

Thanks again for taking the time to meet today — really enjoyed the conversation and learning more about Atlas Health's ingestion pipeline and clinical summarization use case. As promised, I attached the recording and slides and pulled out a couple quick notes below so it's easy to share internally.

Quick recap:
- Primary goal: reduce clinician documentation time by automating encounter summaries; target throughput ~5000 notes/day.
- Key constraints: PHI stays in VPC, retention 90 days, SOC2 evidence required, low 200ms median latency for short responses.
- What stood out: your team already has a consistent schema for encounter notes which should map well to Redwood's structured output + function-calling flow.

Action items / next steps:
1) Recording & slides: https://drive.google.com/atlas-demo-recording (video) / https://drive.google.com/atlas-demo-slides.pdf
2) I can set up a short 15-min Q&A for your engineering and security folks to run through integration questions and SOC2 evidence. Are you available week of Dec 14?
3) I'll open a HubSpot record with the notes and include the SOC2/infosec checklist we mentioned.

If you prefer, Jordan can join the Q&A to cover Dedicated/Private deployment options.

Thanks — and talk soon,
